commits.summary: Record eighteen native results with their JVM startup conditions
commits.body:
The original campaign has 78 native proofs, 29 independently replayed refutations and 18 open startup obligations. The eight chart and ten partial-date companion claims add 14 proofs and four replayed counterexamples on explicitly captured JDK 21 startup states. Together these outcomes agree with all 125 exhaustive JVM dispositions. Keep both scopes in the public register, including each subject, assumption, admitted count, witness, duration and peak process RSS.

All six affected examples validated and all 43 selected test groups passed. Each scoped claim matched the original guard, bounds, class bytes, ordered jars, full independent JVM stream and source control. The claimed initializer class hashes matched the actual bytes on both revisions. All 770 files from the first ten jobs matched the collector. The earlier 36,864-pair ThreeTen chronology grids retained their five verdicts and existing state digest. Both original array-root witnesses and the released LCS score passed again. A separate 3,068,037-date UTC sweep produced the same millisecond stream in Rust and on Temurin 21 and 25. The report's 390 links resolved.

commits.summary: Pair original startup checks with observed runs (verification pending)
commits.body:
Recheck all eight original chart tasks and all ten original partial-date tasks on exactly the respective binary that decided their observed-startup companions. These negative controls require the original strict query to run, to name the ambient initializer call and to publish an unresolved receipt. They reject an unrelated error, changed binary or hidden observed-initializer assumption.

Both job schemas validated and the checks on receipt stage, gap mode and source binding matched all 18 earlier original diagnostics. The changed-test selector chose no inline tests for the manifests. Jobs 20261120-103714-check-chart-startup-without-a-captured-c and 20261120-103714-check-partial-dates-without-captured-pro retain the original 30-second checker budgets, JDK, classpaths, guards and observers.

commits.summary: Publish matched startup refusals in the local claim handoffs
commits.body:
Register an open refusal packet for each of the eight original JFreeChart tasks and ten original Joda-Time tasks. Every pair used the same checker SHA, ordered classpath, guard, observer and 30-second budget as its separately qualified result. Without the captured initializer each check stopped at its original time-zone or provider query. The public gap inventory now links every reproducer and closure check. Semantic refusal reruns preserve an explicitly recorded solver and deadline and distinguish reaching the gap from exhausting the budget.

Both cross-engine conformance jobs passed, in 877 and 1456 seconds including compilation. The complete register covers 125 original claims, 18 additional startup-qualified claims and 126 campaign jobs. All 22 new native decisions resolve through the public handoff. All 18 raw refusals passed their exact-binary controls. All 42 selected test groups passed, the affected examples validated, 393 report links resolved and the 1052 canonical files from this continuation’s 14 jobs matched the collector. The two retained earlier failed jobs name the iterator and exception-message gaps later checks resolved.
